mira_cs: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Solstice next Tue. They had an embeddings spend spike last week and renewal is in 6 weeks. Can we pull a quick cost snapshot and list of enablement asks?
jon_fin: Got it. I pulled raw burn this morning, looks like tokens spiked on 2026-03-15 around 03:00 UTC. Might be an onboarding test gone rogue.
sam_enable: I'll coordinate the enablement items. Quick question: do we want playbook actions (quota, throttles) or customer-facing guidance first?
alexa_se: Recommend both — internal guardrails + a one-page runbook for their ops team. Helps reduce churn.
mira_cs: Agree. Prioritize: 1) immediate throttle/credits ask 2) telemetry gaps 3) QBR slides with forecast scenarios. Sam can you draft the runbook?
sam_enable: On it. Will draft today and share for review. Also can we surface top 5 API routes by token volume?
jon_fin: Yep. Here's a quick query to use in Snowflake:
```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as calls
FROM redwood_prod.token_events
WHERE account_id = 'solstice' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
mira_cs: Perfect — that should show emb-heavy routes. alexa_se, can you check model variants they hit?
alexa_se: Looking now — they're on gpt-xxl and a quantized open model for embeddings. We had an autoswitch policy that may have fallen back to the larger model on 3/15.
jon_fin: If autoswitch bumped them to gpt-xxl that's a billing delta. I can estimate the incremental cost if we get the token counts by model.
sam_enable: Draft runbook plan: short-term: apply per-route soft quota + notify CS at 80% of daily budget. Medium: guide on batching requests and using prefix-KV cache. Long-term: recommended quantization profile and cadence for retraining request patterns.
mira_cs: Nice. Add a clear renewal ask: commit to a dedicated burst pool to cover peak test windows and discounted unit pricing if they commit to 3-month reserve.
deploy-bot: deployment completed: autoswitch-policy v2.4 applied to account solstice at 1766664500
alexa_se: After v2.4 the fallback threshold changed from 10% to 25% free capacity, that should reduce unexpected upsizes.
jon_fin: I'll run a cost delta calc and attach numbers to the QBR. ETA EOD.
sam_enable: Sharing initial runbook draft here in thread once done. I'll include a one-pager for their ops and a bulleted enablement checklist.
mira_cs: For the QBR slides, can someone make 3 forecast scenarios (baseline, test surge, worst-case) with token and $ figures? Baseline = avg last 30 days, test surge = +3x embeddings for one day, worst-case = sustained +60% for 2 weeks.
jon_fin: On it. I'll push a simple table and CSV export.
alexa_se: Also capture recommended immediate actions: toggle autoswitch backstop, enable per-route throttles, reduce model priority on non-critical routes.
mira_cs: Great. If we get these items by EOD tomorrow we can prep slides and send draft to Solstice 48h before the QBR.
sam_enable: Draft will be in thread by 1700 PT. ping me if you want a walkthrough. :thumbsup:
jon_fin: CSV upload link will follow.
mira_cs: Thanks team — this is the plan. I'll create the QBR deck and tag you for review. :rocket:
